parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that supports all internal and external components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity, houses the internal washing system, and supports the door and racks.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is a fixed, non-moving part that maintains the overall shape and stability of the dishwasher.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the dishwasher is a stainless steel panel that seals the washing compartment during operation.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior for loading and unloading dishes and ensures a watertight seal when closed.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about a lower hinge, allowing it to open downward and close securely against the frame.
